spec_section_updates.section_6: AC1 failure: synthesis loop at lines 2368-2382 (handleSidebarDrop, Change 5) scans Object.keys(dayEntry.slots) to find srcOpt, locates it in slot sKey, clones it into srcSlotId.options[], but does NOT remove it from sKey. Option now exists in two slots simultaneously. mealsGroup iterates ['breakfast','lunch','dinner','meals-any'] in fixed order and assigns _originSlotId from whichever slot is first. For items previously moved via applyBridge (dinner to lunch to dinner), the option survives in lunch; mealsGroup hits lunch before dinner and assigns _originSlotId='lunch' (wrong). Live evidence: dinner-1-2 deselected from dinner board shows data-origin-slot-id='lunch' in sidebar.
spec_section_updates.section_7: AC1 fix at scripts/lib/react_template.tpl lines 2368-2382: after pushing the cloned option into dayEntry.slots[srcSlotId].options[], add: `dayEntry.slots[sKey].options = dayEntry.slots[sKey].options.filter(o => o.option_id !== optionId);` Track sKey before the break statement so it is accessible at the removal site. This mirrors applyBridge move semantics at line 2968 — remove from found slot, add to target slot. Without this, clone-without-move permanently corrupts editorTripData state after each cross-slot deselect.

findings.description: handleSidebarDrop synthesis loop (lines 2368-2382, Change 5) finds srcOpt in slot sKey and clones it to srcSlotId.options[] but does NOT remove it from dayEntry.slots[sKey].options[]. findings.proposed_fix: After the push into dayEntry.slots[srcSlotId].options[], add: `dayEntry.slots[sKey].options = dayEntry.slots[sKey].options.filter(o => o.option_id !== optionId);` Declare `let foundSlotKey = null;` before the loop; set `foundSlotKey = sKey;` before break; use `foundSlotKey` in the filter. This mirrors applyBridge move semantics at line 2968.
